content: व्यसनम् .²1 Casting away, dispelling. .²2 Separating, dividing. .²3 Violation, infraction; शीलव्यसनमेतत्ते नाभिजानाम्यहं पुरा <ls>Rām. 2. 12. 57</ls>; <ls>Ki. 3. 45</ls>. .²4 Loss, destruction, defeat, fall; defection, weak point; अमात्यव्यसनम् <ls>Pt. 3</ls>; स्वबलव्यसने <ls>Ki. 13. 15</ls>; <ls>Śi. 2. 57</ls>. .²5 .³({%a%}) A calamity, misfortune, distress, evil, disaster, ill-luck; अज्ञातभर्तृव्यसना मुहूर्तं कृतोपकारेव रतिर्बभूव <ls>Ku. 3. 73</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">4. 30</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 57</ls>. .³({%b%}) Adversity, need; स सुहृद् व्यसने यः स्यात् <ls>Pt. 1. 327</ls> ‘a friend in need is a friend indeed’. .²6 Setting (as of the sun <ab>&c.</ab>); तेजोद्वयस्य युगपद् व्यसनोदयाभ्याम् <ls>Ś. 4. 1</ls> (where व्यसन means ‘a fall’ also). .²7 Vice, bad practice, evil habit; मिथ्यैव व्यसनं वदन्ति मृगयामीदृग् विनोदः कुतः <ls>Ś. 2. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 18. 14</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 310</ls>; (these vices are usually said to be ten; see <ls>Ms. 7. 47-48</ls>); समानशीलव्यसनेषु सख्यम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²8 Close or intent application, assiduous devotion; विद्यायां व्यसनम् <ls>Bh. 2. 62</ls>, <ls n="Bh. 2.">63</ls>. .²9 Inordinate addiction. .²10 Crime, sin. .²11 Punishment. .²12 Inability, incompetency. .²13 Fruitless effort. .²14 Air, wind. .²15 Individuality.
